title: World Oral Health Day 2026 starts now: Download the new video, sing along and join the movement
html:
World Oral Health Day 02/09/2026

Now is the time to start planning for World Oral Health Day (WOHD) 2026. A fun and easy way to begin spreading the message is by sharing the new campaign video and song. Use them during your events and activities — and have fun along the way!

2026: Shines a spotlight on the importance of caring for your mouth at every stage of life—from birth through later years.

To help bring this powerful message to life, FDI World Dental Federation has released an exciting new campaign movie and a catchy theme song, “A Happy Mouth is a Happy Life.” It sets the stage for Toothie’s adventures, where he shows how oral health makes every day better. 

Start your campaign preparations today

Step inside Toothie’s control room and see how happy mouths create days full of happy moments: Download and share the video across your channels to build excitement early and inspire your community to get involved.

Download the video

Sing along!

The campaign song is available on Spotify and all major music streaming platforms — just search for “A Happy Mouth is a Happy Life.”

Bring it into your activities by:

  • Hosting a karaoke session
  • Organising a fun disco or school event
  • Playing it at community gatherings
  • Simply singing along with colleagues and friends
  • Sharing it on social media

Access the song

 

Join the WOHD 2026 campaign webinar – 18 February

On 18 February, FDI will host a one-hour webinar open to everyone interested in participating in WOHD 2026.

The session will explore the campaign’s goals, share practical ideas, and equip participants with tools and resources to raise awareness and drive action. There will also be time for questions and discussion.

Register here

 

Learning objectives

By the end of the webinar, participants will be able to:

  • Understand the 2026 theme: Oral Health Across the Lifespan
  • Inspire action within their communities
  • Use freely available campaign resources effectively
  • Engage different audiences to promote oral health for all

Share your WOHD plans on our map of activities

However you choose to celebrate — big or small — every action makes a difference.

You might:

  • Host an oral hygiene webinar
  • Launch a social media campaign
  • Provide dental check-ups
  • Run school or community education activities

Be sure to register your activity, get mapped, and share your results. Outstanding efforts will be recognised through the World Oral Health Day Awards.

Together, we can spread the message of a #HappyMouth for all.

Keep an eye on Toothie’s Instagram account 

Follow Toothie’s adventures at @toothiebeaver for fun content, ready-to-share posts and campaign moments you can use to energise your own celebrations. Along the way, his friends will join in with friendly “Toothbrush Talks,” sharing how a healthy smile helps you feel your best at every age.

Stay tuned for the return of these popular talks, featuring Lin, Julia, Hans and Olu — bringing together voices from every generation to spread the joy of good oral health throughout life.

Take part in our special activation – launching 13 February

Want to help create buzz around oral health online?

On 13 February, Toothie will invite everyone to share their happy moments — all powered by a healthy smile — using the “Add yours” sticker on Instagram Stories.

The goal? Build a record-breaking chain of smiles around the world by adding your own moment and encouraging others to join in.

It’s quick, fun and an easy way to build momentum and raise awareness about the importance of oral health globally.

Learn more about the activation and how to get involved:

Digital Activation Fact Sheet

Don’t miss the new WOHD campaign resources

Celebrate World Oral Health Day with a wide range of ready-made materials designed to help you raise awareness easily, engage your community and maximise your impact.

New materials are now available in French and Spanish, including:

  • Posters
  • Key advocacy cards
  • Kids’ activity sheets

Additional translations of the Campaign Action Toolkit are coming soon.

Now also available 

Share these assets across all your channels to capture attention and amplify the importance of the day. Inspire others to join the journey toward healthier, happier lives.

Social Medias

Finally, don’t forget to explore all the new Social Media Assets including and Covers to help us spread the work online  

Take me to the resources

 

LET’S MAKE EVERY SMILE A HEALTHIER, HAPPIER ONE!
We’re counting on you to help make WOHD 2026 a truly global movement. We can’t wait to see how you bring the campaign to life in your community!
